beliefs: f shifts each character by +2 in ASCII, but wraps within a character class rather than crossing into the next class [E1, E2, E3, E4]
Lowercase letters shift within a-z with wraparound: h->j, z->b (not |) [E1, E4]
Uppercase letters shift within A-Z with wraparound: A->C, Z->B (not \\) [E2, E3, E4]
Digits shift within 0-9 with wraparound: 0->2, 9->1 (not ;) [E2, E3, E4]
Space shifts to '$' and punctuation shifts by +2 in ASCII without wrapping (e.g. !->%, ~->\u0082) [E2, E3, E4]
notes: The +2 shift is correct but wraps within each alphanumeric class (a-z, A-Z, 0-9) instead of crossing ASCII boundaries; punctuation and space still shift by plain +2. E4's z->b, Z->B, 9->1 confirm the wraparound.
